```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ============================================================
# 0. Setup: packages, paths, prespecified constants, helpers
# ============================================================
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(tibble); library(readr); library(purrr)
  library(ggplot2); library(patchwork); library(ggrepel); library(matrixStats); library(pROC)
})
for (pkg in c("tidyestimate", "coin", "ragg", "ggtext", "systemfonts")) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) install.packages(pkg, repos = "https://cran.r-project.org")
}
HAS_ESTIMATE <- requireNamespace("tidyestimate", quietly = TRUE)
HAS_COIN     <- requireNamespace("coin", quietly = TRUE)

# Project root. here::here() resolves the directory holding the .Rproj or .here
# marker file. Without the here package, set the FERR_ROOT environment variable
# or run from the project root. Matches the two preprocessing pipelines.
if (requireNamespace("here", quietly = TRUE)) {
  root <- here::here()
} else {
  root <- Sys.getenv("FERR_ROOT", unset = normalizePath(getwd(), winslash = "/"))
}
message("Project root: ", root)
paths <- list(
  gse_processed = file.path(root, "GSE96058/02_processed"),
  gse_tables    = file.path(root, "GSE96058/03_results/tables"),
  mb_processed  = file.path(root, "METABRIC/02_processed"),
  # Output of an earlier exploratory pipeline, not distributed with this code.
  # Used only for an optional cross-check of the frozen gene set, which is
  # skipped when the directory is absent.
  old_tables    = file.path(root, "Unified/03_results/tables"),
  out_processed = file.path(root, "Lean/02_processed"),
  out_figures   = file.path(root, "Lean/03_results/figures"),
  out_tables    = file.path(root, "Lean/03_results/tables")
)
invisible(lapply(paths[c("out_processed", "out_figures", "out_tables")], dir.create,
                 recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE))

# Prespecified analysis constants
SPEC <- list(
  seed      = 123,
  B_perm    = 10000,
  fdr       = 0.05,
  min_delta = 0.147,   # Romano et al. "negligible" boundary for Cliff's delta
  n_strata  = 5        # proliferation quintiles for the stratified analysis
)
set.seed(SPEC$seed)

AXES_ORDER   <- readRDS(file.path(paths$gse_processed, "10_axes_order.rds"))
DEFENSE_AXES <- c("Xc_GSH", "GPX4_Selenium", "FSP1_CoQ", "BH4_GCH1", "DHODH_Mito")
AXIS_LABELS  <- c(Xc_GSH = "Xc\u2212/GSH", GPX4_Selenium = "GPX4/selenium", FSP1_CoQ = "FSP1/CoQ",
                  BH4_GCH1 = "BH4/GCH1", DHODH_Mito = "DHODH/mitochondrial", Iron_Handling = "Iron handling",
                  PUFA_Loading = "PUFA loading", Lipid_Peroxidation = "Lipid peroxidation")

# PAM50 proliferation module (Parker 2009 / Nielsen 2010). Used as a multigene
# proliferation covariate. Deliberately strict: PAM50 labels are partly built
# on these genes, so adjusting for them is conservative and may over-adjust.
PAM50_PROLIF_GENES <- c("BIRC5", "CCNB1", "CDC20", "CDC6", "CENPF", "CEP55", "EXO1", "KIF2C", "MELK",
                        "MKI67", "MYBL2", "NDC80", "NUF2", "ORC6", "PTTG1", "RRM2", "TYMS", "UBE2C", "UBE2T")

# Iron handling split by direction of iron flux (the combined axis mixes
# pro- and anti-ferroptotic genes with the same sign and fails to replicate)
IRON_SUBCOMPONENTS <- list(Iron_import  = c("TFRC", "SLC11A2", "STEAP3", "TFR2"),
                           Iron_storage = c("FTH1", "FTL", "NCOA4"),
                           Iron_export  = c("SLC40A1", "HEPH", "CP"))

# Covariate adjustment levels, applied identically to every feature family
ADJ_LEVELS <- list(
  "Raw"                             = character(0),
  "MKI67"                           = "mki67",
  "Proliferation module"            = "prolif_module",
  "Proliferation module + ESTIMATE" = c("prolif_module", "estimate_score")
)

# ---- plotting constants (journal-ready) ---------------------------------
# Figures are sized for a 7.2-inch double column; text is 6.5-10 pt at print size.
# Arial is the default typeface requested by most biomedical journals.
# Okabe-Ito colours are distinguishable with common colour-vision deficiencies.
pick_font <- function(candidates = c("Arial", "Helvetica", "Liberation Sans")) {
  fams <- tryCatch(unique(systemfonts::system_fonts()$family), error = function(e) character(0))
  hit <- candidates[candidates %in% fams]
  if (length(hit)) hit[1] else "sans"
}
FIG_FONT <- pick_font()
update_geom_defaults("text",  list(family = FIG_FONT))
update_geom_defaults("label", list(family = FIG_FONT))

COL_LUMA <- "#2C6FAC"; COL_LUMB <- "#C0392B"
SUBTYPE_COLORS <- c(LumA = COL_LUMA, LumB = COL_LUMB)
COHORT_COLORS  <- c(GSE96058 = "#E69F00", METABRIC = "#0072B2")
ADJ_COLORS <- c("Raw" = "#B8B8B8", "MKI67" = "#E69F00",
                "Proliferation module" = "#56B4E9", "Proliferation module + ESTIMATE" = "#000000")
ADJ_LEGEND <- c("Raw" = "Unadjusted", "MKI67" = "MKI67",
                "Proliferation module" = "Proliferation module",
                "Proliferation module + ESTIMATE" = "Proliferation module + ESTIMATE")
ADJ_TICK_MAP <- c("Raw" = "Unadj.", "MKI67" = "MKI67", "Proliferation module" = "Prolif.",
                  "Proliferation module + ESTIMATE" = "Prolif.\n+ EST.")
ADJ_TICK <- function(b) unname(ADJ_TICK_MAP[b])
SIG_SHAPES <- c("FDR < 0.05" = 16, "FDR \u2265 0.05" = 21)

# Titles and facet strips accept Markdown (ggtext), so gene symbols are set in true italics.
theme_ms <- function(base_size = 8.5) {
  md <- ggtext::element_markdown
  theme_bw(base_size = base_size, base_family = FIG_FONT) +
    theme(text = element_text(colour = "black"),
          axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = base_size - 0.5),
          axis.title = element_text(size = base_size),
          axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey40"),
          plot.title = md(face = "bold", size = base_size + 1.5, margin = margin(b = 3)),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey25", size = base_size - 0.5, margin = margin(b = 5)),
          plot.caption = element_text(colour = "grey35", size = base_size - 1.5, hjust = 0, lineheight = 1.1),
          plot.title.position = "plot", plot.caption.position = "plot",
          plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size + 3),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey94", colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3),
          strip.text.x = md(face = "bold", size = base_size - 0.5, lineheight = 1.2, margin = margin(3, 3, 3, 3)),
          strip.text.y = md(face = "bold", size = base_size - 0.5, lineheight = 1.2, angle = -90,
                            margin = margin(3, 3, 3, 3)),
          panel.border = element_rect(colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.2, colour = "grey92"),
          legend.position = "bottom", legend.spacing.y = unit(1, "pt"),
          legend.key.size = unit(9, "pt"), legend.text = element_text(size = base_size - 0.5),
          legend.title = element_text(size = base_size - 0.5, face = "bold"),
          legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0), legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
}

# Vector PDF (cairo, embeds fonts and Unicode), 600-dpi PNG, and 600-dpi LZW TIFF for submission
save_fig <- function(fig, name, w, h) {
  f <- function(ext) file.path(paths$out_figures, paste0(name, ext))
  pdf_dev <- if (isTRUE(capabilities("cairo"))) grDevices::cairo_pdf else grDevices::pdf
  ggsave(f(".pdf"), fig, width = w, height = h, units = "in", device = pdf_dev, bg = "white")
  if (requireNamespace("ragg", quietly = TRUE)) {
    ggsave(f(".png"),  fig, width = w, height = h, units = "in", dpi = 600, device = ragg::agg_png, bg = "white")
    ggsave(f(".tiff"), fig, width = w, height = h, units = "in", dpi = 600, device = ragg::agg_tiff,
           bg = "white", compression = "lzw")
  } else {
    ggsave(f(".png"),  fig, width = w, height = h, units = "in", dpi = 600, bg = "white")
    ggsave(f(".tiff"), fig, width = w, height = h, units = "in", dpi = 600, bg = "white", compression = "lzw")
  }
}

# ---- statistical helpers ------------------------------------------------

make_gene_z <- function(em) {
  rsd <- matrixStats::rowSds(em, na.rm = TRUE)
  rsd[!is.finite(rsd) | rsd == 0] <- NA_real_
  ez <- (em - rowMeans(em, na.rm = TRUE)) / rsd
  ez[!is.finite(ez)] <- NA_real_
  ez
}

# Equal-weight axis scores. Every axis must be complete in every cohort.
score_axes <- function(ez, axes_list) {
  missing <- purrr::keep(purrr::map(axes_list, ~ setdiff(.x, rownames(ez))), ~ length(.x) > 0)
  if (length(missing)) stop("Incomplete axes: ", paste(names(missing), collapse = ", "))
  t(sapply(axes_list, function(g) colMeans(ez[unique(g), , drop = FALSE])))
}

# Row-safe residualisation on one or more covariates
residualize <- function(y, covs) {
  d <- data.frame(y = y, covs, check.names = FALSE)
  ok <- stats::complete.cases(d)
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(y))
  if (sum(ok) < 50) return(out)
  fit <- stats::lm(y ~ ., data = d[ok, , drop = FALSE])
  out[ok] <- d$y[ok] - stats::predict(fit, newdata = d[ok, , drop = FALSE])
  out
}

# Cliff's delta (LumB vs LumA) = 2*AUC - 1, with a DeLong 95% CI.
# Positive delta = higher in LumB.
group_test <- function(y, grp) {
  a <- y[grp == "LumA" & is.finite(y)]
  b <- y[grp == "LumB" & is.finite(y)]
  if (length(a) < 10 || length(b) < 10) {
    return(tibble(n_LumA = length(a), n_LumB = length(b), delta = NA_real_,
                  delta_lo = NA_real_, delta_hi = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_))
  }
  r  <- pROC::roc(controls = a, cases = b, direction = "<", quiet = TRUE)
  ci <- as.numeric(pROC::ci.auc(r, method = "delong"))
  tibble(n_LumA = length(a), n_LumB = length(b),
         delta = 2 * ci[2] - 1, delta_lo = 2 * ci[1] - 1, delta_hi = 2 * ci[3] - 1,
         p_value = stats::wilcox.test(b, a, exact = FALSE)$p.value)
}

# One engine for every feature family (axes, genes, iron subcomponents, composites).
# BH-FDR is applied within cohort x adjustment level x family.
test_features <- function(fmat, co, family, levels = ADJ_LEVELS) {
  clin <- co$clin
  cov  <- co$covars[match(clin$sample_id, co$covars$sample_id), , drop = FALSE]
  grp  <- as.character(clin$luminal_subtype)
  fmat <- fmat[, clin$sample_id, drop = FALSE]
  res <- purrr::imap(levels, function(vars, lvl) {
    unavailable <- length(vars) > 0 && any(vapply(vars, function(v)
      !(v %in% names(cov)) || all(!is.finite(cov[[v]])), logical(1)))
    if (unavailable) {
      message(co$name, " / ", family, ": skipping '", lvl, "' (covariate unavailable).")
      return(NULL)
    }
    purrr::map_dfr(rownames(fmat), function(f) {
      y <- as.numeric(fmat[f, ])
      if (length(vars)) y <- residualize(y, cov[, vars, drop = FALSE])
      group_test(y, grp) %>% mutate(feature = f, .before = 1)
    }) %>%
      mutate(FDR_BH = p.adjust(p_value, "BH"), adjustment = lvl, cohort = co$name, family = family)
  })
  bind_rows(res) %>% mutate(adjustment = factor(adjustment, levels = names(levels)))
}
```

```{r load-cohorts}
# ============================================================
# 1. Cohorts: PAM50 LumA/LumB, gene-wise z-scores within cohort
# ============================================================
load_cohort <- function(name, expr_path, clin_path) {
  expr <- readRDS(expr_path)
  clin <- readRDS(clin_path) %>% as.data.frame() %>% as_tibble() %>%
    filter(pam50_simple %in% c("LumA", "LumB"), sample_id %in% colnames(expr)) %>%
    mutate(luminal_subtype = factor(as.character(pam50_simple), levels = c("LumA", "LumB")))
  expr <- as.matrix(expr[, clin$sample_id, drop = FALSE])
  if (anyDuplicated(rownames(expr))) stop(name, ": duplicated gene symbols in expression matrix.")
  list(name = name, clin = clin, expr_log = expr, expr_z = make_gene_z(expr))
}

cohorts <- list(
  GSE96058 = load_cohort("GSE96058",
                         file.path(paths$gse_processed, "06_expr_mat_aligned.rds"),
                         file.path(paths$gse_processed, "07_clin_standardized.rds")),
  METABRIC = load_cohort("METABRIC",
                         file.path(paths$mb_processed, "09_expr_PAM50_primary_repSAFE.rds"),
                         file.path(paths$mb_processed, "09_clin_PAM50_primary_repSAFE.rds"))
)

ferro_axes <- readRDS(file.path(paths$gse_processed, "10_ferro_axes_CORE_scoring.rds"))[AXES_ORDER]
GENE_AXIS  <- read_csv(file.path(paths$gse_tables, "10_CORE_ferroptosis_axis_gene_membership.csv"),
                       show_col_types = FALSE) %>% distinct(gene, axis)
```

```{r covariates}
# ============================================================
# 2. Covariates: MKI67, PAM50 proliferation module, ESTIMATE
#    ESTIMATE runs on log-expression (per-sample ssGSEA), never on z-scores.
# ============================================================
run_estimate <- function(expr_log) {
  filt <- tidyestimate::filter_common_genes(as.data.frame(expr_log), id = "hgnc_symbol",
                                            tidy = FALSE, tell_missing = FALSE, find_alias = TRUE)
  sc <- tidyestimate::estimate_score(filt, is_affymetrix = FALSE)
  stopifnot(all(c("sample", "stromal", "immune", "estimate") %in% names(sc)))
  tibble(sample_id = sc$sample, stromal = sc$stromal, immune = sc$immune, estimate_score = sc$estimate)
}

build_covariates <- function(co) {
  ez <- co$expr_z
  pg <- intersect(PAM50_PROLIF_GENES, rownames(ez))
  if (length(pg) < 10) stop(co$name, ": only ", length(pg), " PAM50 proliferation genes available.")
  cov <- tibble(sample_id = colnames(ez), mki67 = as.numeric(ez["MKI67", ]),
                prolif_module = colMeans(ez[pg, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE))
  est <- if (HAS_ESTIMATE) tryCatch(run_estimate(co$expr_log), error = function(e) {
    warning(co$name, ": ESTIMATE failed (", conditionMessage(e), ")."); NULL }) else NULL
  if (is.null(est)) cov <- mutate(cov, stromal = NA_real_, immune = NA_real_, estimate_score = NA_real_)
  else cov <- left_join(cov, est, by = "sample_id")
  attr(cov, "prolif_genes") <- pg
  cov
}

for (nm in names(cohorts)) {
  cohorts[[nm]]$axes   <- score_axes(cohorts[[nm]]$expr_z, ferro_axes)
  cohorts[[nm]]$covars <- build_covariates(cohorts[[nm]])
}

HAS_EST_ALL <- all(vapply(cohorts, function(co) any(is.finite(co$covars$estimate_score)), logical(1)))
PRIMARY_ADJ <- if (HAS_EST_ALL) "Proliferation module + ESTIMATE" else "Proliferation module"
message("Primary adjustment level: ", PRIMARY_ADJ)

cohort_summary <- map_dfr(cohorts, function(co) tibble(
  cohort = co$name, n_LumA = sum(co$clin$luminal_subtype == "LumA"),
  n_LumB = sum(co$clin$luminal_subtype == "LumB"),
  prolif_genes_used = paste(attr(co$covars, "prolif_genes"), collapse = ";"),
  estimate_available = any(is.finite(co$covars$estimate_score))))

# Do the covariates themselves differ by subtype? (MKI67 doubles as a positive control)
covariate_res <- map_dfr(cohorts, function(co) {
  m <- t(as.matrix(co$covars[, c("mki67", "prolif_module", "stromal", "immune", "estimate_score")]))
  colnames(m) <- co$covars$sample_id
  test_features(m, co, "covariate", levels = ADJ_LEVELS["Raw"])
})
print(cohort_summary); print(covariate_res %>% select(cohort, feature, delta, delta_lo, delta_hi))
```
