```{r axis-level}
# ============================================================
# 3. Axis-level LumB vs LumA, all adjustment levels, both cohorts
#    + reproduction of the prespecified discovery rule for the frozen gene set
# ============================================================
axis_res <- map_dfr(cohorts, ~ test_features(.x$axes, .x, "axis"))

# Discovery rule (unchanged from the original pipeline): axis BH-FDR < 0.05 both
# raw and MKI67-corrected in GSE96058. METABRIC is not used.
discovery_axes <- axis_res %>%
  filter(cohort == "GSE96058", adjustment %in% c("Raw", "MKI67")) %>%
  select(feature, adjustment, FDR_BH) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = adjustment, values_from = FDR_BH) %>%
  filter(Raw < SPEC$fdr, MKI67 < SPEC$fdr) %>% pull(feature)

FROZEN_GENES <- GENE_AXIS %>%
  filter(axis %in% discovery_axes, gene %in% rownames(cohorts$GSE96058$expr_z)) %>%
  pull(gene) %>% unique() %>% sort()

old_fp <- file.path(paths$old_tables, "07_frozen_discovery_gene_set.csv")
if (file.exists(old_fp)) {
  old_genes <- read_csv(old_fp, show_col_types = FALSE)$gene
  if (setequal(old_genes, FROZEN_GENES)) {
    message("Frozen gene set reproduces the original pipeline exactly (", length(FROZEN_GENES), " genes).")
  } else {
    warning("Frozen gene set differs from the original pipeline. Only in new: ",
            paste(setdiff(FROZEN_GENES, old_genes), collapse = ", "), " | only in old: ",
            paste(setdiff(old_genes, FROZEN_GENES), collapse = ", "))
  }
}
```

```{r gene-level}
# ============================================================
# 4. Frozen-gene replication across adjustment levels + robust core
#    Core rule (prespecified before looking at the primary-level results):
#    same sign as GSE96058 raw in both cohorts, BH-FDR < 0.05 in both,
#    |Cliff's delta| >= 0.147 in both, at the primary adjustment level.
# ============================================================
gene_res <- map_dfr(cohorts, function(co) {
  miss <- setdiff(FROZEN_GENES, rownames(co$expr_z))
  if (length(miss)) stop(co$name, " is missing frozen genes: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
  test_features(co$expr_z[FROZEN_GENES, , drop = FALSE], co, "gene")
})

discovery_sign <- gene_res %>% filter(cohort == "GSE96058", adjustment == "Raw") %>%
  transmute(feature, discovery_sign = sign(delta))

replication_tbl <- gene_res %>%
  select(feature, cohort, adjustment, delta, delta_lo, delta_hi, FDR_BH) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cohort, values_from = c(delta, delta_lo, delta_hi, FDR_BH)) %>%
  left_join(discovery_sign, by = "feature") %>%
  left_join(GENE_AXIS %>% group_by(gene) %>% summarise(axis = paste(sort(unique(axis)), collapse = ";")),
            by = c("feature" = "gene")) %>%
  mutate(passes_core_rule =
           sign(delta_GSE96058) == discovery_sign & sign(delta_METABRIC) == discovery_sign &
           FDR_BH_GSE96058 < SPEC$fdr & FDR_BH_METABRIC < SPEC$fdr &
           abs(delta_GSE96058) >= SPEC$min_delta & abs(delta_METABRIC) >= SPEC$min_delta)

CORE_GENES <- replication_tbl %>%
  filter(adjustment == PRIMARY_ADJ, passes_core_rule) %>%
  arrange(desc(pmin(abs(delta_GSE96058), abs(delta_METABRIC)))) %>% pull(feature)

replication_summary <- replication_tbl %>% group_by(adjustment) %>%
  summarise(n_genes = n(),
            same_direction = sum(sign(delta_GSE96058) == sign(delta_METABRIC), na.rm = TRUE),
            pearson_r_deltas = cor(delta_GSE96058, delta_METABRIC, use = "complete.obs"),
            n_core = sum(passes_core_rule, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

print(replication_summary)
message("Robust core at '", PRIMARY_ADJ, "': ",
        if (length(CORE_GENES)) paste(CORE_GENES, collapse = ", ") else "none")
```

```{r iron-and-balance}
# ============================================================
# 5. Iron-flux subcomponents and the GCH1-minus-SLC40A1 balance score
# ============================================================
composite_features <- function(co) {
  ez <- co$expr_z
  sub <- map(IRON_SUBCOMPONENTS, function(g) {
    p <- intersect(g, rownames(ez))
    if (!length(p)) return(rep(NA_real_, ncol(ez)))
    colMeans(ez[p, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  })
  rbind(do.call(rbind, sub), GCH1_minus_SLC40A1 = ez["GCH1", ] - ez["SLC40A1", ])
}

iron_availability <- map_dfr(cohorts, function(co) imap_dfr(IRON_SUBCOMPONENTS, ~ tibble(
  cohort = co$name, subcomponent = .y,
  present = paste(intersect(.x, rownames(co$expr_z)), collapse = ";"),
  missing = paste(setdiff(.x, rownames(co$expr_z)), collapse = ";"))))

composite_res <- map_dfr(cohorts, ~ test_features(composite_features(.x), .x, "composite"))

# Are GCH1 and SLC40A1 co-regulated within subtype? (tests the "circuit" idea)
pair_corr <- map_dfr(cohorts, function(co) {
  ez <- co$expr_z; g <- as.character(co$clin$luminal_subtype)
  map_dfr(c("LumA", "LumB"), function(s) {
    ids <- co$clin$sample_id[g == s]
    ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(ez["GCH1", ids], ez["SLC40A1", ids], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
    tibble(cohort = co$name, luminal_subtype = s, n = length(ids), spearman_rho = unname(ct$estimate), p_value = ct$p.value)
  })
})
print(composite_res %>% filter(adjustment %in% c("Raw", PRIMARY_ADJ)) %>%
        select(cohort, adjustment, feature, delta, delta_lo, delta_hi, FDR_BH))
```

```{r hepcidin}
# ============================================================
# 8b. Hepcidin (HAMP) and iron-export capacity
#
# WHERE THIS BELONGS
# ------------------
# This chunk is written for the LEAN pipeline
# (ERplus_Ferroptosis_Lean_v3.Rmd), not the unified pipeline.
#
# Insert it after the composite / iron-flux chunk and before the
# figures chunk. It uses the same objects as every other analysis
# in the paper: cohorts, ADJ_LEVELS, PRIMARY_ADJ, test_features(),
# group_test(), residualize(), SPEC$min_delta, out_tbl(), save_fig().
#
# Every effect size is therefore Cliff's delta with a DeLong 95%
# confidence interval, at all four adjustment levels, with BH-FDR
# applied within cohort x adjustment level x family, exactly as for
# the axes, genes and composites. The numbers are directly
# comparable with the rest of the Results.
#
# WHY
# ---
# Pinnix et al. (Sci Transl Med 2010;2:43ra56) reported that
# ferroportin is lower in the poor-prognosis subtypes including
# luminal B, and that the strongest prognostic separation came from
# ferroportin combined with hepcidin rather than ferroportin alone.
# Hepcidin binds ferroportin and drives its degradation, so HAMP is
# the post-transcriptional brake on iron export.
#
# PRESPECIFICATION
# ----------------
# Added after the primary analyses were complete. The family is
# labelled "hepcidin_posthoc" so it never merges into the primary
# FDR families, and every output carries that label.
# ============================================================

HEPCIDIN_GENES <- c("HAMP", "SLC40A1")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8b.1 Platform presence and detectability
#
# Judged on expr_log, never on expr_z: gene-wise z-scoring rescales
# every gene to the same spread and would make a flat background
# probe look like real signal. A gene counts as background only if
# it falls below the 10th percentile of BOTH median expression and
# variance within its cohort.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

assess_detectability <- function(co, gene, floor_pct = 0.10) {
  em <- co$expr_log
  if (!gene %in% rownames(em)) {
    return(tibble(cohort = co$name, gene = gene, on_platform = FALSE,
                  median_expression = NA_real_, gene_variance = NA_real_,
                  expression_percentile = NA_real_, variance_percentile = NA_real_,
                  n_samples = ncol(em), detectable = FALSE,
                  verdict = "Not present on this platform"))
  }
  v  <- as.numeric(em[gene, ]); v <- v[is.finite(v)]
  gm <- stats::median(v, na.rm = TRUE)
  gv <- stats::var(v, na.rm = TRUE)
  ep <- mean(matrixStats::rowMedians(em, na.rm = TRUE) < gm, na.rm = TRUE)
  vp <- mean(matrixStats::rowVars(em,    na.rm = TRUE) < gv, na.rm = TRUE)
  det <- !(ep < floor_pct && vp < floor_pct)
  tibble(cohort = co$name, gene = gene, on_platform = TRUE,
         median_expression = gm, gene_variance = gv,
         expression_percentile = ep, variance_percentile = vp,
         n_samples = length(v), detectable = det,
         verdict = if (det) "Detectable; analysed"
                   else "At background level; not evaluable")
}

hepcidin_detect <- map_dfr(cohorts, function(co)
  map_dfr(HEPCIDIN_GENES, function(g) assess_detectability(co, g)))

print(hepcidin_detect)

HAMP_OK <- hepcidin_detect %>%
  filter(gene == "HAMP") %>%
  summarise(ok = all(detectable)) %>%
  pull(ok)

if (!isTRUE(HAMP_OK)) {

  message("HAMP is not usable in at least one cohort. ",
          "Reporting detectability only; no hepcidin result.")
  hepcidin_res          <- tibble()
  hepcidin_value_added  <- tibble()
  favourable_composition <- tibble()
  favourable_test       <- tibble()

} else {

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 8b.2 Feature matrix: the two genes plus the export-capacity
  #      composite, run through the paper's own test engine
  #
  # The composite is built from z-scores here and residualised by
  # test_features() at each adjustment level, which matches how
  # GCH1 minus SLC40A1 is handled elsewhere in this pipeline.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  build_hepcidin_matrix <- function(co) {
    ez <- co$expr_z
    stopifnot(all(HEPCIDIN_GENES %in% rownames(ez)))
    hamp    <- as.numeric(ez["HAMP", ])
    ferro   <- as.numeric(ez["SLC40A1", ])
    m <- rbind(HAMP = hamp, SLC40A1 = ferro,
               SLC40A1_minus_HAMP = ferro - hamp)
    colnames(m) <- colnames(ez)
    m
  }

  hepcidin_res <- map_dfr(cohorts, function(co)
    test_features(build_hepcidin_matrix(co), co, "hepcidin_posthoc")) %>%
    mutate(
      magnitude = case_when(
        is.na(delta) ~ "not evaluable",
        abs(delta) <  SPEC$min_delta ~ "negligible",
        abs(delta) <  0.330 ~ "small",
        abs(delta) <  0.474 ~ "medium",
        TRUE ~ "large"
      ),
      direction = case_when(delta > 0 ~ "LumB higher",
                            delta < 0 ~ "LumA higher",
                            TRUE ~ "No shift"),
      analysis_status = "Exploratory, post hoc; separate FDR family"
    ) %>%
    arrange(cohort, feature, adjustment)

  message("Hepcidin and export capacity at the primary adjustment level (",
          PRIMARY_ADJ, "):")
  print(hepcidin_res %>%
          filter(adjustment == PRIMARY_ADJ) %>%
          select(cohort, feature, n_LumA, n_LumB, delta, delta_lo, delta_hi,
                 FDR_BH, magnitude, direction))

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 8b.3 Does the composite earn its place?
  #
  # A composite is worth reporting only if, at the primary
  # adjustment level, it beats the better of its two components in
  # both cohorts. Reported explicitly rather than left to the
  # reader to infer from the table.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  hepcidin_value_added <- hepcidin_res %>%
    filter(adjustment == PRIMARY_ADJ) %>%
    select(cohort, feature, delta) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = feature, values_from = delta) %>%
    mutate(
      best_single_gene = pmax(abs(SLC40A1), abs(HAMP), na.rm = TRUE),
      gain_over_best_single_gene = abs(SLC40A1_minus_HAMP) - best_single_gene,
      verdict = case_when(
        is.na(gain_over_best_single_gene) ~ "not evaluable",
        gain_over_best_single_gene > 0.05 ~ "Composite adds appreciably",
        gain_over_best_single_gene > 0    ~ "Composite adds marginally; prefer SLC40A1",
        TRUE ~ "Composite adds nothing; report SLC40A1 alone"
      ),
      adjustment = PRIMARY_ADJ
    )

  COMPOSITE_REPLICATES <- all(
    hepcidin_value_added$gain_over_best_single_gene > 0.05,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  message("Export-capacity composite, value over its components:")
  print(hepcidin_value_added)
  message("Composite gain replicates in both cohorts: ", COMPOSITE_REPLICATES,
          ". If FALSE, report SLC40A1 alone in the Results and keep the ",
          "composite out of the manuscript.")

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 8b.4 The favourable combination described by Pinnix
  #
  # High ferroportin with low hepcidin, each gene split at its
  # within-cohort median, computed on values residualised at the
  # primary adjustment level so the grouping is net of
  # proliferation and tumour composition.
  #
  # This is a composition test, not a survival test, and it is NOT
  # independent of the SLC40A1 result reported elsewhere, because it
  # is built from median splits of the same measurements.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  favourable_frame <- map_dfr(cohorts, function(co) {
    clin <- co$clin
    cov  <- co$covars[match(clin$sample_id, co$covars$sample_id), , drop = FALSE]
    vars <- ADJ_LEVELS[[PRIMARY_ADJ]]
    ez   <- co$expr_z[, clin$sample_id, drop = FALSE]

    adj <- function(gene) {
      y <- as.numeric(ez[gene, ])
      if (length(vars)) y <- residualize(y, cov[, vars, drop = FALSE])
      y
    }

    tibble(cohort = co$name,
           sample_id = clin$sample_id,
           luminal_subtype = factor(as.character(clin$luminal_subtype),
                                    levels = c("LumA", "LumB")),
           ferroportin_adj = adj("SLC40A1"),
           hepcidin_adj    = adj("HAMP")) %>%
      filter(is.finite(ferroportin_adj), is.finite(hepcidin_adj)) %>%
      mutate(
        ferroportin_level = if_else(
          ferroportin_adj >= stats::median(ferroportin_adj, na.rm = TRUE),
          "high", "low"),
        hepcidin_level = if_else(
          hepcidin_adj >= stats::median(hepcidin_adj, na.rm = TRUE),
          "high", "low"),
        favourable = if_else(
          ferroportin_level == "high" & hepcidin_level == "low",
          "High ferroportin, low hepcidin", "All other combinations")
      )
  })

  # NOTE: dplyr::count() is namespaced deliberately. matrixStats is attached
  # after dplyr in the setup chunk and exports a deprecated count(), which
  # masks dplyr's and fails with "Argument 'x' is not a vector: list".
  favourable_composition <- favourable_frame %>%
    dplyr::count(cohort, luminal_subtype, favourable, name = "n") %>%
    group_by(cohort, luminal_subtype) %>%
    mutate(percent_within_subtype = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(adjustment = PRIMARY_ADJ)

  favourable_test <- favourable_frame %>%
    group_split(cohort) %>%
    map_dfr(function(df) {
      tab <- table(df$luminal_subtype, df$favourable)
      if (nrow(tab) < 2 || ncol(tab) < 2)
        return(tibble(cohort = unique(df$cohort), n_total = sum(tab),
                      odds_ratio_LumB_vs_LumA = NA_real_,
                      ci_low = NA_real_, ci_high = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_))
      ft <- stats::fisher.test(tab)
      tibble(cohort = unique(df$cohort), n_total = sum(tab),
             odds_ratio_LumB_vs_LumA = unname(ft$estimate),
             ci_low = ft$conf.int[1], ci_high = ft$conf.int[2],
             p_value = ft$p.value)
    }) %>%
    mutate(adjustment = PRIMARY_ADJ,
           test = "Fisher exact test on the favourable combination",
           analysis_status = "Exploratory, post hoc; not independent of SLC40A1")

  message("Favourable combination by subtype at the primary adjustment level:")
  print(favourable_composition)
  print(favourable_test)

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 8b.5 Figure: attenuation across adjustment levels
  #
  # Built in the same idiom as Fig 3 so it sits beside the other
  # adjustment-cascade panels.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  hepcidin_fig_df <- hepcidin_res %>%
    filter(is.finite(delta)) %>%
    mutate(feature_label = recode(feature,
             HAMP = "HAMP",
             SLC40A1 = "SLC40A1",
             SLC40A1_minus_HAMP = "SLC40A1 − HAMP"),
           feature_label = factor(feature_label,
             levels = c("HAMP", "SLC40A1", "SLC40A1 − HAMP")))

  fig_hepcidin <- ggplot(hepcidin_fig_df,
                         aes(x = adjustment, y = delta, colour = adjustment)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey40") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(-SPEC$min_delta, SPEC$min_delta),
               linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.25, colour = "grey70") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = delta_lo, ymax = delta_hi),
                  width = 0, linewidth = 0.45) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = FDR_BH < 0.05), size = 1.9, fill = "white") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 16, `FALSE` = 21), guide = "none") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = ADJ_COLORS, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = ADJ_TICK) +
    facet_grid(cohort ~ feature_label) +
    labs(title = "Hepcidin and iron-export capacity across adjustment levels",
         subtitle = paste0("Cliff's δ (LumB relative to LumA) with DeLong 95% CI. ",
                           "Dashed lines mark |δ| = ", SPEC$min_delta,
                           ". Exploratory post hoc analysis"),
         x = "Covariate adjustment", y = "Cliff's δ") +
    theme_ms()

  save_fig(fig_hepcidin, "Working_Hepcidin_Adjustment", 7.2, 4.4)
  fig_hepcidin
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8b.6 Save
#
# Add these lines to the `save` chunk, or leave them here.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

message("Hepcidin chunk complete.")
```

```{r stratified}
# ============================================================
# 6. Within-proliferation-stratum comparison (no regression model)
#    LumA vs LumB compared inside quintiles of the proliferation module;
#    pooled delta weighted by n_LumA * n_LumB; stratified Wilcoxon via coin.
# ============================================================
STRAT_FEATURES <- unique(c(CORE_GENES, "GCH1", "SLC40A1"))

stratified_test <- function(y, grp, strat, k = SPEC$n_strata) {
  bins <- dplyr::ntile(strat, k)
  per <- map_dfr(seq_len(k), ~ group_test(y[bins == .x], grp[bins == .x]) %>% mutate(stratum = .x))
  ok <- is.finite(per$delta); w <- per$n_LumA * per$n_LumB
  p <- NA_real_
  if (HAS_COIN) {
    d <- data.frame(y = y, g = factor(grp, levels = c("LumA", "LumB")), b = factor(bins))
    d <- d[stats::complete.cases(d), ]
    p <- as.numeric(coin::pvalue(coin::wilcox_test(y ~ g | b, data = d)))
  }
  list(per = per, summary = tibble(pooled_delta = if (any(ok)) sum(w[ok] * per$delta[ok]) / sum(w[ok]) else NA_real_,
                                   p_stratified = p, n_strata_used = sum(ok)))
}

strat_out <- map(cohorts, function(co) {
  ez  <- co$expr_z[, co$clin$sample_id]
  fm  <- rbind(ez[STRAT_FEATURES, , drop = FALSE], GCH1_minus_SLC40A1 = ez["GCH1", ] - ez["SLC40A1", ])
  grp <- as.character(co$clin$luminal_subtype)
  pm  <- co$covars$prolif_module[match(co$clin$sample_id, co$covars$sample_id)]
  res <- map(rownames(fm), ~ stratified_test(as.numeric(fm[.x, ]), grp, pm))
  list(per = map2_dfr(res, rownames(fm), ~ mutate(.x$per, feature = .y, cohort = co$name)),
       summary = map2_dfr(res, rownames(fm), ~ mutate(.x$summary, feature = .y, cohort = co$name)))
})
strat_per     <- map_dfr(strat_out, "per")
strat_summary <- map_dfr(strat_out, "summary") %>%
  group_by(cohort) %>% mutate(FDR_BH = p.adjust(p_stratified, "BH")) %>% ungroup()
print(strat_summary)
```

```{r defense-correlation}
# ============================================================
# 7. Supplement: is the defense program more co-regulated in LumB?
#    Within-subtype Spearman structure, label permutation test.
# ============================================================
mean_abs_r <- function(m) {
  m <- m[stats::complete.cases(m), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(m) < 20) return(NA_real_)
  cm <- cor(m, method = "spearman"); mean(abs(cm[upper.tri(cm)]))
}
coherence_test <- function(co) {
  m <- t(co$axes[DEFENSE_AXES, co$clin$sample_id]); g <- as.character(co$clin$luminal_subtype)
  a <- mean_abs_r(m[g == "LumA", ]); b <- mean_abs_r(m[g == "LumB", ])
  set.seed(SPEC$seed)
  null <- replicate(SPEC$B_perm, { s <- sample(g); mean_abs_r(m[s == "LumB", ]) - mean_abs_r(m[s == "LumA", ]) })
  null <- null[is.finite(null)]
  list(test = tibble(cohort = co$name, mean_abs_r_LumA = a, mean_abs_r_LumB = b, diff_LumB_minus_LumA = b - a,
                     p_perm = if (is.finite(b - a)) (sum(abs(null) >= abs(b - a)) + 1) / (length(null) + 1) else NA_real_,
                     n_perm = length(null)),
       corr = bind_rows(
         as.data.frame(cor(m[g == "LumA", ], method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")) %>%
           rownames_to_column("axis_x") %>% pivot_longer(-axis_x, names_to = "axis_y", values_to = "r") %>%
           mutate(luminal_subtype = "LumA"),
         as.data.frame(cor(m[g == "LumB", ], method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")) %>%
           rownames_to_column("axis_x") %>% pivot_longer(-axis_x, names_to = "axis_y", values_to = "r") %>%
           mutate(luminal_subtype = "LumB")) %>% mutate(cohort = co$name))
}
coherence_out  <- map(cohorts, coherence_test)
coherence_perm <- map_dfr(coherence_out, "test")
print(coherence_perm)
```

```{r survival}
# ============================================================
# 8b. Survival: does the GCH1-minus-SLC40A1 balance score grade
#     outcome among luminal tumours, independent of subtype,
#     proliferation and purity?
#
# Prespecified before any model was fitted:
#   Features    GCH1, SLC40A1, GCH1_minus_SLC40A1, z-scored within cohort,
#               so every hazard ratio is per 1 SD
#   Direction   the model predicts HIGHER balance = WORSE outcome (HR > 1)
#   Subtype     enters as strata(), not as a covariate. The question is
#               whether the score grades risk INSIDE a subtype, not whether
#               it rediscovers the subtype. Stratification also avoids
#               assuming proportional hazards between LumA and LumB.
#   Endpoints   PRIMARY   overall survival, the only endpoint both cohorts share
#               SECONDARY (METABRIC only, prespecified)
#                 breast-cancer-specific survival: 351 of the 693 METABRIC
#                 deaths are from other causes, so OS over 28 years of
#                 follow-up in a cohort aged 26 to 92 is heavily diluted
#                 relapse-free survival: 458 events, undiluted by competing death
#   Adjustment  mirrors ADJ_LEVELS from the expression analysis exactly
#   Clinical    METABRIC only. GSE96058 carries no stage, grade, size, node
#               or treatment data, so the clinicopathological model cannot
#               be run there and this is stated rather than worked around.
#   Multiplicity  BH-FDR within cohort x endpoint x model
#
# Requires: cohorts, ADJ_LEVELS, PRIMARY_ADJ, SPEC, theme_ms(), save_fig()
# ============================================================

if (!requireNamespace("survival", quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages("survival", repos = "https://cran.r-project.org")
library(survival)

SURV_SPEC <- list(
  features        = c("GCH1", "SLC40A1", "GCH1_minus_SLC40A1"),
  direction_claim = "higher balance score predicts worse outcome (HR > 1)",
  min_events      = 50,   # below this a cohort x endpoint is reported, not interpreted
  n_groups_km     = 3
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8b.1  Endpoint definitions, hard-coded from the clinical objects
#
#   GSE96058  os_days   integer, 56 to 2473 (median 1654, so median
#                       follow-up is about 4.5 years and the cohort is
#                       event-poor by construction)
#             os_event  integer 0/1
#   METABRIC  OS_MONTHS   0.1 to 337.0 (median 122)
#             OS_STATUS   "1:DECEASED" (693) / "0:LIVING" (482)
#             VITAL_STATUS "Living" (482) / "Died of Disease" (341) /
#                          "Died of Other Causes" (351) / "" (1)
#             RFS_MONTHS / RFS_STATUS  "1:Recurred" (458) / "0:Not Recurred" (716)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
SURV_ENDPOINTS <- list(
  GSE96058 = list(
    OS   = list(time = "os_days",    event = "os_event",     units = "days",   kind = "OS")
  ),
  METABRIC = list(
    OS   = list(time = "OS_MONTHS",  event = "OS_STATUS",    units = "months", kind = "OS"),
    DSS  = list(time = "OS_MONTHS",  event = "VITAL_STATUS", units = "months", kind = "DSS"),
    RFS  = list(time = "RFS_MONTHS", event = "RFS_STATUS",   units = "months", kind = "RFS")
  )
)

# Clinical covariates for the fully adjusted model. NPI is used in the primary
# clinical model because it combines size, nodes and grade into one validated
# index and has zero missing values in this cohort, whereas grade (50 missing),
# nodes (35) and size (6) would together drop about 80 patients. The individual
# components are kept as a prespecified sensitivity analysis.
SURV_CLINICAL <- list(
  GSE96058 = list(primary = character(0), sensitivity = character(0)),
  METABRIC = list(
    primary     = c("age", "npi", "hormone_therapy", "chemotherapy"),
    sensitivity = c("age", "grade", "log_size", "log_nodes", "hormone_therapy", "chemotherapy")
  )
)

normalise_event <- function(v, kind) {
  if (kind == "DSS") {
    # Death from another cause is CENSORED, not an event. The blank value is
    # treated as unknown and dropped rather than silently counted as alive.
    s <- trimws(as.character(v))
    out <- rep(NA_integer_, length(s))
    out[grepl("^Died of Disease$",      s, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- 1L
    out[grepl("^Died of Other Causes$", s, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- 0L
    out[grepl("^Living$",               s, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- 0L
    return(out)
  }
  if (is.logical(v)) return(as.integer(v))
  if (is.numeric(v)) {
    u <- sort(unique(v[is.finite(v)]))
    if (all(u %in% c(0, 1))) return(as.integer(v))
    stop("Unrecognised numeric event coding: ", paste(u, collapse = ", "))
  }
  s <- toupper(trimws(as.character(v)))
  out <- rep(NA_integer_, length(s))
  out[grepl("^1:|DECEASED|RECURRED$", s)] <- 1L
  out[grepl("^0:|LIVING|NOT RECURRED", s)] <- 0L
  out
}

to_months <- function(x, units) switch(units,
  days = x / 30.4375, months = x, years = x * 12,
  stop("units must be days, months or years"))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8b.2  One analysis frame per cohort x endpoint
# ------------------------------------------------------------
build_surv_frame <- function(co, endpoint, spec) {
  cl  <- co$clin
  ez  <- co$expr_z
  cov <- co$covars[match(cl$sample_id, co$covars$sample_id), , drop = FALSE]
  z   <- function(x) { x <- as.numeric(x); (x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) }
  gc  <- function(nm) if (nm %in% names(cl)) cl[[nm]] else rep(NA, nrow(cl))

  df <- tibble(
    cohort          = co$name,
    endpoint        = endpoint,
    sample_id       = cl$sample_id,
    luminal_subtype = factor(as.character(cl$luminal_subtype), levels = c("LumA", "LumB")),
    time            = to_months(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(cl[[spec$time]])), spec$units),
    event           = normalise_event(cl[[spec$event]], spec$kind),
    GCH1               = z(ez["GCH1", cl$sample_id]),
    SLC40A1            = z(ez["SLC40A1", cl$sample_id]),
    GCH1_minus_SLC40A1 = z(ez["GCH1", cl$sample_id] - ez["SLC40A1", cl$sample_id]),
    prolif_module   = z(cov$prolif_module),
    estimate_score  = if (any(is.finite(cov$estimate_score))) z(cov$estimate_score) else NA_real_,
    age             = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gc("AGE_AT_DIAGNOSIS"))),
    npi             = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gc("NPI"))),
    grade           = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gc("GRADE"))),
    log_size        = log1p(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gc("TUMOR_SIZE")))),
    log_nodes       = log1p(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gc("LYMPH_NODES_EXAMINED_POSITIVE")))),
    hormone_therapy = factor(as.character(gc("HORMONE_THERAPY")), levels = c("NO", "YES")),
    chemotherapy    = factor(as.character(gc("CHEMOTHERAPY")),    levels = c("NO", "YES"))
  ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(time), time > 0, !is.na(event))

  df
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8b.3  Model ladder. The first three mirror ADJ_LEVELS; the fourth asks
#       whether the score adds anything to standard clinicopathology.
# ------------------------------------------------------------
build_model_list <- function(cohort_name) {
  cl <- SURV_CLINICAL[[cohort_name]]
  m <- list(
    "Unadjusted"                      = character(0),
    "Proliferation module"            = "prolif_module",
    "Proliferation module + ESTIMATE" = c("prolif_module", "estimate_score")
  )
  if (length(cl$primary))
    m[["Proliferation + ESTIMATE + clinical"]] <- c("prolif_module", "estimate_score", cl$primary)
  if (length(cl$sensitivity))
    m[["Clinical components (sensitivity)"]]   <- c("prolif_module", "estimate_score", cl$sensitivity)
  m
}

usable <- function(d, v) {
  if (!v %in% names(d)) return(FALSE)
  x <- d[[v]]
  if (is.factor(x) || is.character(x)) return(length(unique(stats::na.omit(as.character(x)))) > 1)
  any(is.finite(x)) && stats::sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
}

fit_one <- function(df, feature, covars, subtype = NA_character_) {
  d <- df
  if (!is.na(subtype)) d <- d %>% filter(luminal_subtype == subtype)
  covars <- covars[vapply(covars, function(v) usable(d, v), logical(1))]
  keep <- c("time", "event", feature, covars)
  d <- d[stats::complete.cases(d[, keep, drop = FALSE]), , drop = FALSE]
  n_ev <- sum(d$event == 1)
  blank <- tibble(feature = feature, n = nrow(d), n_events = n_ev,
                  HR = NA_real_, HR_lo = NA_real_, HR_hi = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_,
                  concordance = NA_real_, ph_p = NA_real_, covariates = paste(covars, collapse = "+"),
                  note = "too few events for a stable fit")
  # about 10 events per estimated parameter
  if (nrow(d) < 30 || n_ev < 10 * (length(covars) + 1)) return(blank)

  rhs <- paste(c(feature, covars, if (is.na(subtype)) "strata(luminal_subtype)"), collapse = " + ")
  fit <- tryCatch(survival::coxph(stats::as.formula(paste("Surv(time, event) ~", rhs)), data = d),
                  error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) return(blank %>% mutate(note = "model failed to converge"))
  s  <- summary(fit)
  ph <- tryCatch(survival::cox.zph(fit)$table[feature, "p"], error = function(e) NA_real_)

  tibble(feature = feature, n = s$n, n_events = s$nevent,
         HR    = unname(s$coefficients[feature, "exp(coef)"]),
         HR_lo = unname(s$conf.int[feature, "lower .95"]),
         HR_hi = unname(s$conf.int[feature, "upper .95"]),
         p_value     = unname(s$coefficients[feature, "Pr(>|z|)"]),
         concordance = unname(s$concordance[1]),
         ph_p = ph, covariates = paste(covars, collapse = "+"), note = NA_character_)
}

surv_frames <- list(); surv_res <- tibble(); surv_within <- tibble()
surv_inter  <- tibble(); surv_constraint <- tibble(); surv_competing <- tibble()

for (co in cohorts) {
  mods <- build_model_list(co$name)
  for (ep in names(SURV_ENDPOINTS[[co$name]])) {
    spec <- SURV_ENDPOINTS[[co$name]][[ep]]
    df <- build_surv_frame(co, ep, spec)
    surv_frames[[paste(co$name, ep, sep = "_")]] <- df

    # pooled across subtypes, stratified by subtype
    surv_res <- bind_rows(surv_res, imap_dfr(mods, function(cv, lab)
      map_dfr(SURV_SPEC$features, ~ fit_one(df, .x, cv)) %>%
        mutate(cohort = co$name, endpoint = ep, model = lab,
               scope = "All luminal (subtype-stratified)")))

    # within each subtype separately
    surv_within <- bind_rows(surv_within, map_dfr(c("LumA", "LumB"), function(st)
      imap_dfr(mods, function(cv, lab)
        map_dfr(SURV_SPEC$features, ~ fit_one(df, .x, cv, subtype = st)) %>%
          mutate(cohort = co$name, endpoint = ep, model = lab, scope = paste0("Within ", st)))))

    # does the score mean the same thing in both subtypes?
    cv <- mods[["Proliferation module + ESTIMATE"]]
    cv <- cv[vapply(cv, function(v) usable(df, v), logical(1))]
    surv_inter <- bind_rows(surv_inter, map_dfr(SURV_SPEC$features, function(f) {
      d <- df[stats::complete.cases(df[, c("time", "event", f, cv), drop = FALSE]), ]
      if (sum(d$event == 1) < SURV_SPEC$min_events)
        return(tibble(cohort = co$name, endpoint = ep, feature = f,
                      p_interaction = NA_real_, note = "too few events"))
      f0 <- survival::coxph(stats::as.formula(paste("Surv(time, event) ~",
             paste(c(f, cv, "strata(luminal_subtype)"), collapse = " + "))), data = d)
      f1 <- survival::coxph(stats::as.formula(paste("Surv(time, event) ~",
             paste(c(f, cv, paste0(f, ":luminal_subtype"), "strata(luminal_subtype)"),
                   collapse = " + "))), data = d)
      tibble(cohort = co$name, endpoint = ep, feature = f,
             p_interaction = stats::anova(f0, f1)$`Pr(>|Chi|)`[2], note = NA_character_)
    }))

    # ---- is the balance score a legitimate summary of its two genes? ----
    # The score is the two-gene model under the constraint beta_GCH1 = -beta_SLC40A1,
    # which is nested inside the free model. A 1-df likelihood-ratio test asks
    # whether collapsing the two genes into one score costs anything. This is an
    # empirical justification for the composite that does not rest on
    # prespecification, and it is the same question the hepcidin composite failed.
    d <- df[stats::complete.cases(df[, c("time", "event", "GCH1", "SLC40A1", cv),
                                     drop = FALSE]), ]
    if (sum(d$event == 1) >= SURV_SPEC$min_events) {
      free <- survival::coxph(stats::as.formula(paste("Surv(time, event) ~",
        paste(c("GCH1", "SLC40A1", cv, "strata(luminal_subtype)"), collapse = " + "))), data = d)
      cons <- survival::coxph(stats::as.formula(paste("Surv(time, event) ~",
        paste(c("GCH1_minus_SLC40A1", cv, "strata(luminal_subtype)"), collapse = " + "))), data = d)
      ll_f <- as.numeric(stats::logLik(free)); ll_c <- as.numeric(stats::logLik(cons))
      surv_constraint <- bind_rows(surv_constraint, tibble(
        cohort = co$name, endpoint = ep, n = nrow(d), n_events = sum(d$event == 1),
        beta_GCH1 = unname(stats::coef(free)["GCH1"]),
        beta_SLC40A1 = unname(stats::coef(free)["SLC40A1"]),
        loglik_two_gene = ll_f, loglik_balance = ll_c, lrt_df = 1,
        p_constraint = stats::pchisq(2 * (ll_f - ll_c), df = 1, lower.tail = FALSE),
        c_index_balance  = unname(summary(cons)$concordance[1]),
        c_index_two_gene = unname(summary(free)$concordance[1])))
    }

    # ---- competing risks, for the disease-specific endpoint only ----
    # Censoring 351 other-cause deaths assumes independent censoring, which is
    # doubtful in a cohort followed to age 92. Fine-Gray on the subdistribution
    # hazard makes no such assumption and is reported as a sensitivity analysis.
    if (spec$kind == "DSS" && "VITAL_STATUS" %in% names(co$clin)) {
      st <- trimws(as.character(co$clin$VITAL_STATUS))[match(df$sample_id, co$clin$sample_id)]
      cr <- df %>% mutate(
        cr_status = factor(dplyr::case_when(
          grepl("^Died of Disease$", st, ignore.case = TRUE)      ~ "disease",
          grepl("^Died of Other Causes$", st, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "other",
          grepl("^Living$", st, ignore.case = TRUE)               ~ "censor",
          TRUE ~ NA_character_), levels = c("censor", "disease", "other"))) %>%
        filter(!is.na(cr_status))
      cr <- cr[stats::complete.cases(cr[, c("time", "GCH1_minus_SLC40A1", cv), drop = FALSE]), ]
      fg <- tryCatch({
        fgd <- survival::finegray(Surv(time, cr_status) ~ ., data = cr, etype = "disease")
        m <- survival::coxph(stats::as.formula(paste("Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~",
               paste(c("GCH1_minus_SLC40A1", cv), collapse = " + "))),
               weights = fgwt, data = fgd)
        s <- summary(m)
        tibble(cohort = co$name, endpoint = "DSS (Fine-Gray subdistribution)",
               feature = "GCH1_minus_SLC40A1",
               sHR    = unname(s$coefficients["GCH1_minus_SLC40A1", "exp(coef)"]),
               sHR_lo = unname(s$conf.int["GCH1_minus_SLC40A1", "lower .95"]),
               sHR_hi = unname(s$conf.int["GCH1_minus_SLC40A1", "upper .95"]),
               p_value = unname(s$coefficients["GCH1_minus_SLC40A1", "Pr(>|z|)"]),
               note = "Subtype not stratified: finegray() does not accept strata")
      }, error = function(e) tibble(cohort = co$name, endpoint = "DSS (Fine-Gray subdistribution)",
               feature = "GCH1_minus_SLC40A1", sHR = NA_real_, sHR_lo = NA_real_, sHR_hi = NA_real_,
               p_value = NA_real_, note = paste("failed:", conditionMessage(e))))
      surv_competing <- bind_rows(surv_competing, fg)
    }
  }
}

# BH-FDR within cohort x endpoint x model
fdr_within <- function(x) x %>% group_by(cohort, endpoint, scope, model) %>%
  mutate(FDR_BH = p.adjust(p_value, "BH")) %>% ungroup() %>%
  select(cohort, endpoint, scope, model, feature, n, n_events, HR, HR_lo, HR_hi,
         p_value, FDR_BH, concordance, ph_p, covariates, note)
surv_res    <- fdr_within(surv_res)
surv_within <- fdr_within(surv_within)

# ---- follow-up and event accounting: this decides what may be interpreted ----
surv_followup <- map_dfr(surv_frames, function(df) {
  km <- survival::survfit(Surv(time, 1 - event) ~ 1, data = df)   # reverse Kaplan-Meier
  tibble(cohort = df$cohort[1], endpoint = df$endpoint[1],
         n = nrow(df), n_events = sum(df$event == 1), event_rate = mean(df$event == 1),
         median_followup_months = unname(summary(km)$table["median"]),
         max_followup_months = max(df$time, na.rm = TRUE),
         events_LumA = sum(df$event == 1 & df$luminal_subtype == "LumA"),
         events_LumB = sum(df$event == 1 & df$luminal_subtype == "LumB"),
         interpretable = sum(df$event == 1) >= SURV_SPEC$min_events)
})

print(surv_followup)
print(surv_res %>% filter(model == "Proliferation module + ESTIMATE") %>%
        select(cohort, endpoint, feature, n_events, HR, HR_lo, HR_hi, FDR_BH, ph_p))
if (nrow(surv_constraint)) print(surv_constraint %>%
        select(cohort, endpoint, beta_GCH1, beta_SLC40A1, p_constraint,
               c_index_balance, c_index_two_gene))
if (nrow(surv_competing)) print(surv_competing)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8b.4  Figure: Kaplan-Meier by within-subtype tertiles of the balance score
#       DISPLAY ONLY. Every inference above is from the Cox model on the
#       continuous, adjusted score. The caption says so.
#
#       Each cohort is drawn on its own follow-up and survival scale and
#       combined with patchwork. facet_grid(scales = "free_x") frees the x
#       axis per column, and the columns are LumA/LumB, so a shared grid
#       forced GSE96058 (81 months, survival above 87%) onto METABRIC's
#       0-337 month, 0-100% axes and flattened it. Numbers at risk added.
# ------------------------------------------------------------
KM_SHOW <- c("GSE96058_OS", "METABRIC_OS")

km_one_cohort <- function(df, show_legend = FALSE, show_subtitle = FALSE) {

  d <- df %>%
    group_by(luminal_subtype) %>%
    mutate(balance_group = cut(
      GCH1_minus_SLC40A1,
      breaks = stats::quantile(GCH1_minus_SLC40A1, c(0, 1/3, 2/3, 1), na.rm = TRUE),
      labels = c("Low", "Middle", "High"), include.lowest = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(!is.na(balance_group))

  curves <- map_dfr(split(d, list(d$luminal_subtype, d$balance_group), drop = TRUE), function(g) {
    f <- survival::survfit(Surv(time, event) ~ 1, data = g)
    tibble(luminal_subtype = g$luminal_subtype[1], balance_group = g$balance_group[1],
           time = c(0, f$time), surv = c(1, f$surv))
  })

  tmax   <- max(df$time, na.rm = TRUE)
  breaks <- pretty(c(0, tmax), n = 5)
  breaks <- breaks[breaks <= tmax]
  ymin   <- max(0, floor(min(curves$surv, na.rm = TRUE) / 0.25) * 0.25)

  # numbers still under observation at each break
  risk <- map_dfr(split(d, list(d$luminal_subtype, d$balance_group), drop = TRUE), function(g)
    tibble(luminal_subtype = g$luminal_subtype[1], balance_group = g$balance_group[1],
           time = breaks, n_risk = vapply(breaks, function(t) sum(g$time >= t), integer(1))))

  p_km <- ggplot(curves, aes(time, surv, colour = balance_group)) +
    geom_step(linewidth = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~ luminal_subtype, nrow = 1) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(Low = "#0072B2", Middle = "grey60", High = "#C0392B"),
                        name = "Balance score (within-subtype tertile)") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = breaks, limits = c(0, tmax), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.03))) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(ymin, 1), labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    labs(title = paste0(df$cohort[1], ", overall survival"),
         subtitle = if (show_subtitle)
           paste("The score separates outcome within LumA and not within LumB in both cohorts",
                 "(subtype interaction P = 0.022 in GSE96058 and 2.0 × 10⁻⁴ in METABRIC).\n",
                 "Tertiles are shown for display only; all inference is from Cox models on the continuous, adjusted score.")
           else NULL,
         x = NULL, y = "Overall survival") +
    theme_ms() +
    theme(legend.position = if (show_legend) "bottom" else "none",
          plot.title = ggtext::element_markdown(face = "bold", size = 9))

  p_risk <- ggplot(risk, aes(time, balance_group)) +
    geom_text(aes(label = n_risk, colour = balance_group), size = 2.3, show.legend = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(~ luminal_subtype, nrow = 1) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(Low = "#0072B2", Middle = "grey60", High = "#C0392B")) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = breaks, limits = c(0, tmax), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.03))) +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(c("Low", "Middle", "High"))) +
    labs(x = "Months from diagnosis", y = NULL, tag = NULL) +
    theme_ms() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.border = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6.5), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
          strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_blank(),
          plot.margin = margin(1, 4, 2, 4))

  (p_km / p_risk) + patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(1, 0.22))
}

km_parts <- imap(surv_frames[intersect(KM_SHOW, names(surv_frames))], function(df, nm) {
  if (sum(df$event == 1) < SURV_SPEC$min_events) return(NULL)
  km_one_cohort(df,
                show_legend   = identical(nm, tail(intersect(KM_SHOW, names(surv_frames)), 1)),
                show_subtitle = identical(nm, intersect(KM_SHOW, names(surv_frames))[1]))
})
km_parts <- Filter(Negate(is.null), km_parts)

if (length(km_parts)) {
  FigS4_Survival_Balance <- patchwork::wrap_plots(km_parts, ncol = 1) +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(
      title = "Overall survival by *GCH1* − *SLC40A1* balance score",
      caption = paste("Numbers below each panel are patients still under observation.",
                      "Each cohort is drawn on its own follow-up scale:",
                      "GSE96058 reaches 81 months, METABRIC 337."),
      theme = theme_ms() + theme(
        plot.title = ggtext::element_markdown(face = "bold", size = 11),
        plot.caption = element_text(colour = "grey35", size = 6.5, hjust = 0)))
  save_fig(FigS4_Survival_Balance, "FigS4_Survival_Balance", w = 7.2, h = 7.4)
}

message("Survival analysis complete.")
```

```{r figures, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=5, dpi=150}
# ============================================================
# Figure file names match the manuscript exactly.
#   Fig1-Fig5                        main figures 1-5
#   FigS1_Covariates_by_Subtype      Supplementary Figure 1
#   FigS2_Defense_Axis_Coexpression  Supplementary Figure 2
#   FigS3_Proliferation_Stratified   Supplementary Figure 3
#   FigS4_Survival_Balance           Supplementary Figure 4  (built in the survival chunk)
#   Working_Hepcidin_Adjustment      not shown in the manuscript; kept so the
#                                    post hoc hepcidin analysis stays reproducible
#                                    and can be supplied if a reviewer asks.
# ============================================================
# ============================================================
# 8. Figures: 5 main, 3 supplementary (typeface Arial, gene symbols italic via ggtext)
#    Sized for a 7.2-inch double column so text is 7-9 pt at print size.
#    Conventions used in every effect-size figure:
#      filled symbol = BH-FDR < 0.05, open symbol = FDR >= 0.05,
#      grey band     = |Cliff's delta| < 0.147 (negligible effect),
#      positive delta = higher in LumB.
# ============================================================

# ---- figure helpers ---------------------------------------------------------
fmt_ci  <- function(d, lo, hi) gsub("-", "\u2212", sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", d, lo, hi))
sig_lab <- function(fdr) factor(ifelse(!is.na(fdr) & fdr < SPEC$fdr, "FDR < 0.05", "FDR \u2265 0.05"),
                                levels = names(SIG_SHAPES))
md_p <- function(p) vapply(p, function(x) {
  if (is.na(x)) return("*P* = NA")
  if (x >= 0.001) return(sprintf("*P* = %.3f", x))
  e <- floor(log10(x))
  sprintf("*P* = %.1f \u00d7 10<sup>%s</sup>", x / 10^e, gsub("-", "\u2212", as.character(e)))
}, character(1))
minus <- function(x) gsub("-", "\u2212", x)
md_gene <- function(x) ifelse(x == "GCH1_minus_SLC40A1", "*GCH1* \u2212 *SLC40A1*", paste0("*", x, "*"))

cohort_lab <- setNames(
  sprintf("%s<br><span style='font-size:7pt;'>LumA n = %s \u00b7 LumB n = %s</span>", cohort_summary$cohort,
          prettyNum(cohort_summary$n_LumA, big.mark = ","), prettyNum(cohort_summary$n_LumB, big.mark = ",")),
  cohort_summary$cohort)
adj_legend <- function(b) ifelse(b == PRIMARY_ADJ, paste0(ADJ_LEGEND[b], " (primary)"), ADJ_LEGEND[b])
sig_guides <- guides(colour = guide_legend(order = 1, nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE, override.aes = list(shape = 16, linetype = 0, size = 2)),
                     shape  = guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(colour = "black", size = 2)))
band_h <- function() annotate("rect", xmin = -SPEC$min_delta, xmax = SPEC$min_delta, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
                              fill = "grey88", alpha = 0.7)
band_v <- function() annotate("rect", ymin = -SPEC$min_delta, ymax = SPEC$min_delta, xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf,
                              fill = "grey88", alpha = 0.7)
delta_lab <- "Cliff's \u03b4 (LumB vs LumA)"

# Horizontal forest plots use explicit numeric offsets so that dodging works
# identically in every ggplot2 version and with free facet scales.
adj_offset <- function(adj, width = 0.72) {
  k <- length(levels(adj)); ((k + 1) / 2 - as.integer(adj)) * width / k   # unadjusted on top
}

# ---- Fig 1: axis-level forest plot ---------------------------------------------
fig1_df <- axis_res %>%
  mutate(axis_pos = match(feature, rev(AXES_ORDER)) + adj_offset(adjustment),
         class    = factor(ifelse(feature %in% DEFENSE_AXES, "Defense", "Susceptibility"),
                           levels = c("Defense", "Susceptibility")),
         sig      = sig_lab(FDR_BH))

fig1 <- ggplot(fig1_df, aes(x = delta, y = axis_pos, colour = adjustment)) +
  band_h() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = delta_lo, xmax = delta_hi), linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = sig), size = 1.7, fill = "white", stroke = 0.6) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq_along(AXES_ORDER), labels = function(b) unname(AXIS_LABELS[rev(AXES_ORDER)][b]),
                     expand = expansion(add = 0.45)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = ADJ_COLORS, labels = adj_legend, name = "Adjustment") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = SIG_SHAPES, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(class ~ cohort, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", labeller = labeller(cohort = cohort_lab)) +
  sig_guides + theme_ms() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), legend.box = "vertical") +
  labs(title = "Ferroptosis axis activity in Luminal B relative to Luminal A",
       subtitle = "Cliff's \u03b4 with DeLong 95% CI at four levels of covariate adjustment",
       caption = paste0("Grey band: negligible effect (|\u03b4| < ", SPEC$min_delta,
                        "). Filled symbols: BH-FDR < 0.05 within cohort and adjustment level."),
       x = delta_lab, y = NULL)
save_fig(fig1, "Fig1_Axis_Activity_Adjustment", 7.2, 4.6)

# ---- Fig 2: discovery vs replication concordance ------------------------------
conc_levels <- c("Concordant, FDR < 0.05 in both", "Concordant, not significant in both", "Discordant direction")
fig2_df <- replication_tbl %>%
  filter(adjustment %in% c("Raw", PRIMARY_ADJ)) %>%
  mutate(status = case_when(
           sign(delta_GSE96058) != sign(delta_METABRIC) ~ conc_levels[3],
           FDR_BH_GSE96058 < SPEC$fdr & FDR_BH_METABRIC < SPEC$fdr ~ conc_levels[1],
           TRUE ~ conc_levels[2]),
         status = factor(status, levels = conc_levels),
         min_abs = pmin(abs(delta_GSE96058), abs(delta_METABRIC))) %>%
  group_by(adjustment) %>%
  mutate(rk = rank(-ifelse(status == conc_levels[1], min_abs, -Inf), ties.method = "first"),
         show_label = (status == conc_levels[1] & rk <= 10) | feature %in% c("GCH1", "SLC40A1", "DHFR")) %>%
  ungroup()

lim2 <- ceiling(10 * max(abs(unlist(fig2_df[, c("delta_lo_GSE96058", "delta_hi_GSE96058",
                                                 "delta_lo_METABRIC", "delta_hi_METABRIC")])), na.rm = TRUE)) / 10
fig2_stats <- fig2_df %>% group_by(adjustment) %>%
  summarise(label = sprintf("Pearson r = %.2f\n%d of %d genes concordant\n%d concordant with FDR < 0.05 in both",
                            cor(delta_GSE96058, delta_METABRIC, use = "complete.obs"),
                            sum(status != conc_levels[3]), n(), sum(status == conc_levels[1])),
            .groups = "drop")
panel_lab2 <- function(x) ifelse(x == "Raw", "Unadjusted", paste0(x, " (primary)"))

fig2 <- ggplot(fig2_df, aes(delta_GSE96058, delta_METABRIC)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = lim2, ymin = 0, ymax = lim2, fill = "#EAF2F8") +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -lim2, xmax = 0, ymin = -lim2, ymax = 0, fill = "#EAF2F8") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey45") +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = delta_lo_GSE96058, xmax = delta_hi_GSE96058, colour = status), linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.45) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = delta_lo_METABRIC, ymax = delta_hi_METABRIC, colour = status), linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.45) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = status, size = status)) +
  scale_size_manual(values = c(1.8, 1.2, 1.4), breaks = conc_levels, guide = "none") +
  geom_text_repel(data = filter(fig2_df, show_label), aes(label = feature), size = 2.4, fontface = "italic",
                  family = FIG_FONT,
                  min.segment.length = 0, segment.size = 0.2, box.padding = 0.3, max.overlaps = 30,
                  seed = SPEC$seed) +
  geom_label(data = fig2_stats, aes(x = -lim2, y = lim2, label = label), hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
             size = 2.4, lineheight = 0.95, fill = "white", label.size = 0, alpha = 0.85,
             label.padding = unit(3, "pt"), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#0072B2", "grey65", "#D55E00"), breaks = conc_levels, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(-lim2, lim2), ylim = c(-lim2, lim2), expand = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ adjustment, labeller = as_labeller(panel_lab2)) +
  theme_ms() +
  labs(title = "Replication of the frozen discovery gene set in METABRIC",
       subtitle = paste0(nrow(fig2_df) / 2, " genes selected in GSE96058 and tested unchanged. ",
                         "Error bars: 95% CI in each cohort. Shaded quadrants: same direction."),
       x = paste0(delta_lab, ", GSE96058 (discovery)"), y = paste0(delta_lab, ", METABRIC (replication)"))
save_fig(fig2, "Fig2_Discovery_Replication_Concordance", 7.2, 4.4)

# ---- Fig 3: gene-level adjustment cascade --------------------------------------
concordant_primary <- replication_tbl %>%
  filter(adjustment == PRIMARY_ADJ,
         sign(delta_GSE96058) == discovery_sign, sign(delta_METABRIC) == discovery_sign,
         FDR_BH_GSE96058 < SPEC$fdr, FDR_BH_METABRIC < SPEC$fdr) %>%
  mutate(min_abs = pmin(abs(delta_GSE96058), abs(delta_METABRIC))) %>%
  arrange(desc(min_abs))
CASCADE_GENES <- unique(c(CORE_GENES, "GCH1", "SLC40A1", head(concordant_primary$feature, 7), "DHFR"))

gene_axis_first <- GENE_AXIS %>% group_by(gene) %>% summarise(axis = first(axis), .groups = "drop")
cascade_facet <- function(g) {
  ax <- AXIS_LABELS[gene_axis_first$axis[match(g, gene_axis_first$gene)]]
  sprintf("*%s*<br><span style='font-size:6.5pt;color:#4D4D4D;'>%s axis</span>", g, ifelse(is.na(ax), "", ax))
}
fig3_df <- gene_res %>%
  filter(feature %in% CASCADE_GENES) %>%
  mutate(facet = factor(cascade_facet(feature), levels = cascade_facet(CASCADE_GENES)),
         sig   = sig_lab(FDR_BH))
dodge_c <- position_dodge(width = 0.45)

fig3 <- ggplot(fig3_df, aes(x = adjustment, y = delta, colour = cohort, group = cohort)) +
  band_v() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_line(position = dodge_c, linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = delta_lo, ymax = delta_hi), position = dodge_c, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = sig), position = dodge_c, size = 1.7, fill = "white", stroke = 0.6) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = ADJ_TICK) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = COHORT_COLORS, name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = SIG_SHAPES, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ facet, ncol = 4) +
  sig_guides + theme_ms() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6.5, lineheight = 0.85), legend.box = "horizontal") +
  labs(title = "Attenuation of gene-level effects with increasing adjustment",
       subtitle = paste0("Genes concordant with BH-FDR < 0.05 in both cohorts under the primary adjustment. ",
                         "The last panel is a proliferation-driven contrast."),
       caption = paste0("Unadj., unadjusted. Prolif., PAM50 proliferation module. EST., ESTIMATE score. ",
                        "Grey band: |\u03b4| < ", SPEC$min_delta, "."),
       x = NULL, y = delta_lab)
save_fig(fig3, "Fig3_Gene_Adjustment_Cascade", 7.2, 1.3 + 2.0 * ceiling(length(CASCADE_GENES) / 4))

# ---- Fig 4: iron-flux components and the GCH1-minus-SLC40A1 balance -----------
iron_df <- composite_res %>%
  filter(feature %in% names(IRON_SUBCOMPONENTS)) %>%
  mutate(component = factor(c(Iron_import = "Import", Iron_storage = "Storage", Iron_export = "Export")[feature],
                            levels = c("Import", "Storage", "Export")),
         sig = sig_lab(FDR_BH))
dodge_a <- position_dodge(width = 0.7)

p4a <- ggplot(iron_df, aes(component, delta, colour = adjustment, group = adjustment)) +
  band_v() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = delta_lo, ymax = delta_hi), position = dodge_a, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = sig), position = dodge_a, size = 1.7, fill = "white", stroke = 0.6) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = ADJ_COLORS, labels = adj_legend, name = "Adjustment") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = SIG_SHAPES, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ cohort) + sig_guides + theme_ms() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "vertical") +
  labs(tag = "A", title = "Iron-flux components", x = NULL, y = delta_lab)

# Panel B deliberately does NOT colour by cohort. Panel A already uses colour for
# the adjustment level, and COHORT_COLORS reuses the same orange and a near-identical
# blue, so a shared legend would give one colour two meanings inside one figure.
# Here colour keeps its panel-A meaning and cohort is carried by linetype, which is
# also safe under common colour-vision deficiencies.
bal_df <- composite_res %>% filter(feature == "GCH1_minus_SLC40A1") %>% mutate(sig = sig_lab(FDR_BH))
p4b <- ggplot(bal_df, aes(adjustment, delta, group = cohort)) +
  band_v() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_line(aes(linetype = cohort), position = dodge_c, linewidth = 0.4, colour = "grey45") +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = delta_lo, ymax = delta_hi, colour = adjustment),
                 position = dodge_c, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = sig, colour = adjustment), position = dodge_c,
             size = 1.9, fill = "white", stroke = 0.6) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = ADJ_TICK) +
  expand_limits(y = 0) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = ADJ_COLORS, labels = adj_legend, name = "Adjustment") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(GSE96058 = "solid", METABRIC = "22"), name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = SIG_SHAPES, name = NULL, drop = FALSE, guide = "none") +
  guides(linetype = guide_legend(order = 3, override.aes = list(colour = "grey45"))) +
  theme_ms() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6.5, lineheight = 0.85)) +
  labs(tag = "B", title = "*GCH1* \u2212 *SLC40A1* balance score",
       x = NULL, y = delta_lab)

fig4 <- (p4a | p4b) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1.7, 1), guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(caption = paste(strwrap(paste0(
    paste(sprintf("%s: %s", c("Import", "Storage", "Export"),
                  vapply(IRON_SUBCOMPONENTS, paste, character(1), collapse = ", ")), collapse = ". "),
    ". Grey band: |\u03b4| < ", SPEC$min_delta, ". Filled symbols: BH-FDR < 0.05. ",
    "In B, colour is the adjustment level as in A and linetype is the cohort: solid GSE96058, dashed METABRIC."), width = 118), collapse = "\n"),
    theme = theme_ms()) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "vertical")
save_fig(fig4, "Fig4_Iron_Flux_and_Balance", 7.2, 3.9)

# ---- Fig 5: GCH1, SLC40A1 and balance by subtype -------------------------------
feat5_levels <- c("*GCH1*", "*SLC40A1*", "*GCH1* \u2212 *SLC40A1*")
fig5_df <- map_dfr(cohorts, function(co) {
  ids <- co$clin$sample_id
  tibble(cohort = co$name, luminal_subtype = co$clin$luminal_subtype,
         GCH1 = co$expr_z["GCH1", ids], SLC40A1 = co$expr_z["SLC40A1", ids]) %>%
    mutate(balance = GCH1 - SLC40A1)
}) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(GCH1, SLC40A1, balance), names_to = "feature", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(feature = factor(c(GCH1 = feat5_levels[1], SLC40A1 = feat5_levels[2], balance = feat5_levels[3])[feature],
                          levels = feat5_levels))

fig5_ann <- bind_rows(
  gene_res %>% filter(feature %in% c("GCH1", "SLC40A1")),
  composite_res %>% filter(feature == "GCH1_minus_SLC40A1")) %>%
  mutate(feature = md_gene(feature)) %>%
  filter(adjustment %in% c("Raw", PRIMARY_ADJ)) %>%
  arrange(cohort, feature, adjustment) %>%
  mutate(txt = paste0(ifelse(adjustment == "Raw", "Unadjusted \u03b4 = ", "Adjusted \u03b4 = "),
                      fmt_ci(delta, delta_lo, delta_hi))) %>%
  group_by(cohort, feature) %>%
  summarise(label = paste(txt, collapse = "\n"), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(feature = factor(feature, levels = feat5_levels))

fig5 <- ggplot(fig5_df, aes(luminal_subtype, value)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.25, colour = "grey60", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_violin(aes(fill = luminal_subtype), colour = NA, alpha = 0.35, scale = "width", trim = TRUE) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(colour = luminal_subtype), width = 0.18, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(data = fig5_ann, aes(x = 1.5, y = Inf, label = label), vjust = 1.25, size = 2.2,
            lineheight = 0.95, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = SUBTYPE_COLORS, guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = SUBTYPE_COLORS, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.24))) +
  facet_grid(cohort ~ feature, scales = "free_y", labeller = labeller(cohort = cohort_lab)) +
  theme_ms() +
  labs(title = "*GCH1* and *SLC40A1* expression by luminal subtype",
       subtitle = paste0("Gene-wise z-scores within cohort. Adjusted: ", PRIMARY_ADJ, ". \u03b4 with 95% CI."),
       x = NULL, y = "Expression (z-score)")
save_fig(fig5, "Fig5_GCH1_SLC40A1_by_Subtype", 7.2, 5.2)

# ---- Fig S1: comparison within proliferation quintiles ------------------------
strat_levels <- md_gene(unique(strat_summary$feature))
figS3_df <- strat_per %>% filter(is.finite(delta)) %>%
  mutate(feature = factor(md_gene(feature), levels = strat_levels),
         stratum = factor(paste0("Q", stratum), levels = paste0("Q", seq_len(SPEC$n_strata))),
         n_lab = paste0(n_LumA, "/", n_LumB), w = n_LumA * n_LumB, sig = sig_lab(p_value))
figS1_pool <- strat_summary %>%
  mutate(feature = factor(md_gene(feature), levels = strat_levels),
         label = sprintf("Pooled \u03b4 = %s, %s", minus(sprintf("%.2f", pooled_delta)), md_p(p_stratified)))

figS3 <- ggplot(figS3_df, aes(stratum, delta, colour = cohort)) +
  band_v() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(data = figS1_pool, aes(yintercept = pooled_delta, colour = cohort), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = delta_lo, ymax = delta_hi), linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(size = w, shape = sig), fill = "white", stroke = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(y = -Inf, label = n_lab), vjust = -0.5, size = 2, colour = "grey30") +
  ggtext::geom_richtext(data = figS1_pool, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label), hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
                        size = 2.4, family = FIG_FONT, fill = NA, label.colour = NA,
                        label.padding = unit(c(4, 4, 4, 5), "pt"), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = COHORT_COLORS, guide = "none") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("FDR < 0.05" = 16, "FDR \u2265 0.05" = 21),
                     labels = c("P < 0.05", "P \u2265 0.05"), name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 3, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.2, 0.25))) +
  facet_grid(feature ~ cohort, labeller = labeller(cohort = cohort_lab)) +
  theme_ms() +
  labs(title = "Luminal B vs Luminal A within quintiles of the PAM50 proliferation module",
       subtitle = "Numbers: LumA/LumB tumours per quintile. Dashed line: pooled within-stratum \u03b4 (stratified Wilcoxon P).",
       caption = "Quintiles with fewer than 10 tumours of either subtype are omitted. Symbol size is proportional to nLumA \u00d7 nLumB.",
       x = "Proliferation-module quintile (Q1 = lowest)", y = delta_lab)
save_fig(figS3, "FigS3_Proliferation_Stratified", 7.2, 1.4 + 1.6 * length(strat_levels))

# ---- Fig S2: within-subtype co-expression of defense axes (LumA vs LumB) -----
s2_pairs <- map_dfr(coherence_out, "corr") %>%
  mutate(ix = match(axis_x, DEFENSE_AXES), iy = match(axis_y, DEFENSE_AXES)) %>%
  filter(ix < iy) %>%
  mutate(pair = paste0(AXIS_LABELS[axis_x], " \u2013 ", AXIS_LABELS[axis_y])) %>%
  select(cohort, pair, luminal_subtype, r)
s2_order <- s2_pairs %>% group_by(pair) %>% summarise(m = mean(r), .groups = "drop") %>% arrange(m) %>% pull(pair)
s2_pairs <- s2_pairs %>% mutate(pair = factor(pair, levels = s2_order),
                                luminal_subtype = factor(luminal_subtype, levels = c("LumA", "LumB")))
s2_wide  <- s2_pairs %>% pivot_wider(names_from = luminal_subtype, values_from = r)
s2_means <- coherence_perm %>%
  select(cohort, LumA = mean_abs_r_LumA, LumB = mean_abs_r_LumB) %>%
  pivot_longer(-cohort, names_to = "luminal_subtype", values_to = "m")
s2_strip <- coherence_perm %>%
  transmute(cohort, lab = sprintf(
    "%s<br><span style='font-size:7pt;'>mean |\u03c1|: LumA %.2f \u00b7 LumB %.2f<br>permutation *P* = %.3f</span>",
    cohort, mean_abs_r_LumA, mean_abs_r_LumB, p_perm))

figS2 <- ggplot() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(data = s2_means, aes(xintercept = m, colour = luminal_subtype), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.55) +
  geom_segment(data = s2_wide, aes(x = LumA, xend = LumB, y = pair, yend = pair), colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(data = s2_pairs, aes(x = r, y = pair, colour = luminal_subtype), size = 2.2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = SUBTYPE_COLORS, name = NULL) +
  facet_wrap(~ cohort, labeller = as_labeller(setNames(s2_strip$lab, s2_strip$cohort))) +
  theme_ms() + theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.2, colour = "grey90")) +
  labs(title = "Co-expression of defense axes within each luminal subtype",
       subtitle = paste0("Spearman \u03c1 for each of the 10 axis pairs, computed separately in LumA and LumB. ",
                         "Dashed lines: mean |\u03c1| per subtype."),
       caption = "Permutation test of the LumB minus LumA difference in mean |\u03c1|, 10,000 random relabellings of subtype.",
       x = "Spearman \u03c1 between axis scores", y = NULL)
save_fig(figS2, "FigS2_Defense_Axis_Coexpression", 7.2, 4)

# ---- Fig S3: covariates that motivate the adjustment ---------------------------
COV_LABELS <- c(mki67 = "MKI67", prolif_module = "Prolif. module", stromal = "Stromal score", immune = "Immune score")
figS1_df <- map_dfr(cohorts, function(co) co$covars %>%
  mutate(cohort = co$name, luminal_subtype = co$clin$luminal_subtype[match(sample_id, co$clin$sample_id)])) %>%
  select(cohort, luminal_subtype, all_of(names(COV_LABELS))) %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(names(COV_LABELS)), names_to = "feature", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter(is.finite(value))
s3_panel <- function(cohort, feature) paste0(COV_LABELS[feature], "<br><span style='font-size:7pt;'>", cohort, "</span>")
s3_levels <- as.vector(outer(names(COV_LABELS), names(cohorts), function(f, c) s3_panel(c, f)))
figS1_df <- figS1_df %>% mutate(panel = factor(s3_panel(cohort, feature), levels = s3_levels))
figS3_ann <- covariate_res %>% filter(feature %in% names(COV_LABELS), is.finite(delta)) %>%
  mutate(panel = factor(s3_panel(cohort, feature), levels = s3_levels),
         label = paste0("\u03b4 = ", fmt_ci(delta, delta_lo, delta_hi)))

figS1 <- ggplot(figS1_df, aes(luminal_subtype, value)) +
  geom_violin(aes(fill = luminal_subtype), colour = NA, alpha = 0.35, scale = "width") +
  geom_boxplot(aes(colour = luminal_subtype), width = 0.18, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(data = figS3_ann, aes(x = 1.5, y = Inf, label = label), vjust = 1.4, size = 2.2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = SUBTYPE_COLORS, guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = SUBTYPE_COLORS, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.2))) +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, ncol = length(COV_LABELS), scales = "free_y") +
  theme_ms() +
  labs(title = "Proliferation and tumour composition by luminal subtype",
       subtitle = "Covariates used for adjustment. \u03b4 with 95% CI, positive = higher in LumB.",
       caption = "MKI67 and the PAM50 proliferation module are gene-wise z-scores. Stromal and immune scores are ESTIMATE scores.",
       x = NULL, y = "Score")
save_fig(figS1, "FigS1_Covariates_by_Subtype", 7.2, 4.4)

fig1; fig2; fig3; fig4; fig5
```

```{r save}
# ============================================================
# 9. Tables, objects, session info

out_tbl <- function(x, f) write_csv(x, file.path(paths$out_tables, f))
out_tbl(cohort_summary,      "T01_cohort_summary.csv")
out_tbl(covariate_res,       "T02_covariates_by_subtype.csv")

out_tbl(tibble(gene = FROZEN_GENES, discovery_axes = paste(discovery_axes, collapse = ";")),
        "T04_frozen_discovery_gene_set.csv")

out_tbl(replication_tbl,     "T06_gene_replication_and_core_rule.csv")
out_tbl(replication_summary, "T07_replication_summary.csv")
out_tbl(composite_res,       "T08_iron_flux_and_balance.csv")
out_tbl(iron_availability,   "T09_iron_gene_availability.csv")
out_tbl(pair_corr,           "T10_GCH1_SLC40A1_within_subtype_correlation.csv")
out_tbl(strat_summary,       "T11_proliferation_stratified_summary.csv")
out_tbl(strat_per,           "T12_proliferation_stratified_per_quintile.csv")
out_tbl(coherence_perm,      "T13_defense_coregulation_permutation.csv")
out_tbl(hepcidin_detect,    "T14_hepcidin_detectability.csv")
if (exists("hepcidin_res") && nrow(hepcidin_res)) {
  out_tbl(hepcidin_res,           "T15_hepcidin_results_all_adjustments.csv")
  out_tbl(hepcidin_value_added,   "T16_hepcidin_composite_value_added.csv")
  out_tbl(favourable_composition, "T17_favourable_combination_composition.csv")
  out_tbl(favourable_test,        "T18_favourable_combination_test.csv")
}

if (exists("surv_res") && nrow(surv_res)) {
  out_tbl(surv_followup,   "T19_survival_followup_and_events.csv")
  out_tbl(surv_res,        "T20_survival_cox_subtype_stratified.csv")
  out_tbl(surv_within,     "T21_survival_cox_within_subtype.csv")
  out_tbl(surv_inter,      "T22_survival_subtype_interaction.csv")
  if (nrow(surv_constraint)) out_tbl(surv_constraint, "T23_balance_score_constraint_LRT.csv")
  if (nrow(surv_competing))  out_tbl(surv_competing,  "T24_DSS_competing_risks_finegray.csv")
}

saveRDS(list(cohort_summary = cohort_summary, axis_res = axis_res, gene_res = gene_res,
             replication_tbl = replication_tbl, composite_res = composite_res,
             strat_summary = strat_summary, coherence_perm = coherence_perm,
             CORE_GENES = CORE_GENES, PRIMARY_ADJ = PRIMARY_ADJ, SPEC = SPEC),
        file.path(paths$out_processed, "lean_results.rds"))

writeLines(c(
  "STATISTICAL METHODS NOTES (for the Methods section)",
  "Subtypes: PAM50 LumA vs LumB. Expression z-scored gene-wise within each cohort.",
  "Axis scores: equal-weight mean of member-gene z-scores; complete axes required in both cohorts.",
  "Effect size: Cliff's delta (LumB vs LumA) computed as 2*AUC - 1, 95% CI from DeLong AUC variance.",
  "Tests: two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum; BH-FDR within cohort x adjustment level x feature family.",
  "Adjustment: linear residualisation on MKI67, on the PAM50 proliferation-module mean z-score,",
  "  and on the proliferation module plus the ESTIMATE score (tidyestimate, non-Affymetrix mode).",
  "Frozen gene set: all genes of axes with BH-FDR < 0.05 raw and MKI67-corrected in GSE96058;",
  "  tested unchanged in METABRIC.",
  paste0("Robust core: at '", PRIMARY_ADJ, "', same sign as GSE96058 raw, BH-FDR < 0.05 and |delta| >= ",
         SPEC$min_delta, " in both cohorts."),
  "Stratified analysis: proliferation-module quintiles, weighted pooled delta, coin stratified Wilcoxon.",
  "Survival: Cox proportional hazards. Features z-scored within cohort, so each",
  "  hazard ratio is per 1 SD. PAM50 subtype entered as a stratification term, not a",
  "  covariate, so no proportional-hazards assumption is made between LumA and LumB.",
  "  Adjustment levels mirror the expression analysis; a clinicopathological model",
  "  adding age, Nottingham Prognostic Index and endocrine and chemotherapy use was",
  "  fitted in METABRIC only, because GSE96058 carries no stage, grade, size, node or",
  "  treatment data.",
  "Endpoints: overall survival in both cohorts (the only shared endpoint). In METABRIC,",
  "  breast-cancer-specific survival (other-cause deaths censored) and relapse-free",
  "  survival were prespecified secondary endpoints, because 351 of 693 METABRIC deaths",
  "  were from other causes. Disease-specific survival was repeated as a Fine-Gray",
  "  subdistribution model treating other-cause death as a competing risk.",
  "Proportional hazards assessed by scaled Schoenfeld residuals (cox.zph).",
  "BH-FDR within cohort x endpoint x model. Kaplan-Meier tertiles are display only.",
  "The equal-and-opposite constraint implied by the GCH1-minus-SLC40A1 score was tested",
  "  against the free two-gene model by a 1-df likelihood-ratio test.",
  paste0("Co-regulation: within-subtype mean |Spearman r| among defense axes, ", SPEC$B_perm, " label permutations.")
), file.path(paths$out_tables, "Methods_statistics_notes.txt"))
writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()), file.path(paths$out_tables, "session_info.txt"))
message("Lean pipeline complete. Core genes: ", paste(CORE_GENES, collapse = ", "))
```
